title: Integrative project: machine data checks plus separate ungraded human portfolio

questions.prompt: RNA-layer normalization and processing controls. Authored form A. Use form A of integrative-project-candidate-cultures.csv. Each of six conditions has four separately prepared cultures measured at 0 and 48 h, not matched donors across conditions. RNA and protein have backgrounds and recovery references; marker/function counts use viable cells. Signaling channels summarize matched 0,10,30-min aliquots from that culture. Cells and repeated times are not independent cultures. Matrix-high conditions also have different accessible ligand, so matrix effects are confounded. No calibrated uncertainty, joint cell states or clinical inference is supplied.

response_fields.prompt: Which RNA interpretation respects processing and abundance?
options: A shared-region abundance proves every transcript has the same splice pattern.
A shared-region abundance readout does not specify isoform composition or a processing route.
More RNA proves a unique spliceosome defect.

response_fields.prompt: For signal_high culture 01 at 48 h calculate corrected RNA eq per 1000 viable cells on a bare eq-per-1000 scale. Report exactly 3 significant figures.
Which RNA assay follow-up separates a processing claim?
options: Only repeat the same shared amplicon and call it isoform resolution.
Isoform-specific and precursor readouts with no-RT, recovery and perturbation controls, plus production/decay evidence.
Use total protein as a no-RT control.

response_fields.prompt: Calculate equal-culture mean both-condition signaling trapezoidal area on the bare AU-minute scale. Report exactly 3 significant figures.
Which intervention interpretation respects these data?
options: Any condition named rescue proves a unique pathway.
The condition contrasts describe measured output; the named rescue alone does not locate one unique pathway or prove on-target specificity.
An endpoint marker directly measures upstream target engagement.
Use cell count alone as a direct feedback assay.
Match exposure, ligand availability and receptor state; add target-engagement and orthogonal interventions over time.
Pool culture aliquots to create independent biological repeats.

questions.prompt: Factorial marker contrast and separate function boundary. Authored form A. Use form A of integrative-project-candidate-cultures.csv. Each of six conditions has four separately prepared cultures measured at 0 and 48 h, not matched donors across conditions. RNA and protein have backgrounds and recovery references; marker/function counts use viable cells. Signaling channels summarize matched 0,10,30-min aliquots from that culture. Cells and repeated times are not independent cultures. Matrix-high conditions also have different accessible ligand, so matrix effects are confounded. No calibrated uncertainty, joint cell states or clinical inference is supplied.

response_fields.prompt: Calculate endpoint marker interaction (both-matrix_high)-(signal_high-control) on a bare percentage-point scale. Report exactly 3 significant figures.
Which follow-up resolves the deliberate confound and marker/function gap?
options: Factorially match accessible ligand and cell state, measure geometry/material time dependence and analyze marker and function separately.
Use marker positivity to replace the distinct function readout.
Declare the matrix-modulus difference the unique cause despite ligand mismatch.

response_fields.prompt: Which interpretation of the project is justified?
options: A positive interaction is proof of clinical regeneration.
Synthetic in-vitro contrasts support only the stated measurements; clinical benefit requires much more evidence and oversight.
A nominal rescue eliminates all alternatives and safety questions.
